messages:
eli: quick question — we found a batch of debug traces in s3 that include a customer_id in the first line. retention policy says 30d but wants pii redacted. who is allowed to request a one-off purge or approve keeping a redacted copy?

maria: @eli can you paste an example path?

eli: sure — s3://redwood-logs/traces/prod/2026-03-15/trace-7f3a1.log (first line: "customer_id=acct_ABC123 request_id=...")

jamie: if it contains clear customer_id that's in scope for redaction/erase. short answer: you need a retention-exception OR perform a scrub and a validated purge.

sec-bot: policy note: traces containing PII must be either redacted in-place or removed. See https://redwood.internal/policy/data-retention (linked). :eyes:

eli: ok — what's the operational path? can devs run rm on the s3 prefix?

ops: devs do NOT have blanket delete perms on that bucket. Only infra-admins or oncall with an approval ticket can run destructive s3 ops. We use the s3-safe-delete runbook.

ops: runbook gist: 1) open compliance ticket (jira RED-SEC-erase) with justification + retention exception OR stated scrub script; 2) Security approval; 3) infra oncall schedules a controlled delete job (aws cli + inventory) and posts dry-run output; 4) final delete after 24h window.

maria: for redaction instead of delete we recommend the redact pipeline: small python job that rewrites objects replacing customer_id with <REDACTED>. sample sed-ish lambda:

```
# naive example — run in controlled env
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-logs/traces/prod/2026-03-15/trace-7f3a1.log - | \
  sed -E 's/customer_id=[^\t ]+\/ /customer_id=<REDACTED> /g' | \
  aws s3 cp - s3://redwood-logs/traces/prod/2026-03-15/trace-7f3a1.redacted.log
```

jamie: ^ don't run that blindly — test on a copy and include hash checksums. Also update the manifest so we don't leave orphaned pointers.

eli: perfecto. i'll open the compliance ticket and attach a sample set + dry-run plan. tagging @jamie for sec approval once it's up. thanks. :thumbsup:

maria: FYI we also have lifecycle rules for older traces — consider adding a tag to avoid accidental delete if you want to keep redacted versions longer.

ops: if you need infra to run the delete, ping #eng-oncall and include the jira link. we'll include the dry-run output in the ticket as evidence.

eli: filing now — will post the ticket here when created.

jamie: thanks. if anything looks sensitive beyond customer_id, flag it in the ticket (payment, ssn, oauth tokens) so we can escalate.

eli: will do.
